prompt:
/arm-new-track calendar/sync/ implement two-way sync with external calendars.

[User pasted PRD excerpt]: The CalendarSyncWorker polls GoogleCalendarClient.listEvents() and OutlookGraphClient.getCalendarView() every 60s per connected account using sync_token / deltaLink cursors stored in calendar_sync_cursors. Conflicts are detected by comparing updated_at against last_synced_at in calendar_event_mirror. The ConflictResolver currently throws ConflictError and aborts the whole batch. Rate limits: Google 1,000,000 queries/day/project, Microsoft Graph 10,000 requests/10 min/app. Events can be recurring (RRULE) with exceptions (EXDATE, RECURRENCE-ID). [Agent has completed Steps 1-4.] Begin the interview with Round 1, Question 1. The first open decision is what happens when the same event was edited on both sides between syncs.
qualities: Despite the identifier-heavy PRD, the opener describes the conflict in terms of what the person sees (which edit wins, whether anything is lost) with no class, method, table, or column names.
Class and table names from the PRD, if mentioned at all, appear only in the Safe to ignore line.
The whole body from headline to last Pick line stays compact (about 180 words, never more than 200) rather than restating the PRD.
Each numbered option is a single line containing both a benefit and a cost.
